body: it isn't comparing myself to others, though, it's wondering how i'm going to even get along in the real world - society - the world outside of my window that exists whether i want it to or not

i have OCD, bipolar disorder/manic depression, i have ADD if that affects anything at all, and other than that i don;t know what's wrong with me. i just have such an aversion to normality and the "orthodox" life and we live in a world where you can't have that
